items.title: Shops get their logo
items.text: Type Kaufland, mega or Lidl Romania and the shop shows its own logo. Local shops get their first letter.

items.title: Pick a date from a calendar
items.text: Tap a task's date and a month calendar opens right in the sheet. Clear date is one tap.

items.title: New versions wait for you
items.text: When an update is ready, a small pill offers Refresh. It never reloads on its own or while you're typing.

items.title: Every day on screen, listed
items.text: Under the Timeline you now see what's in the days on screen, not just the one you tapped.

fixes: Names on the Timeline stay put while you swipe
A new list's name is ready to type over

items.title: Trips and holidays, one row each
items.text: The new Timeline shows the big stuff side by side and swipes freely, with Agenda and Month a tap away.

items.title: Move a task to any list
items.text: Pick a list, or make a new one with its own icon and colour, without leaving the task.

items.title: Tasks, redesigned
items.text: Lists with sub-tasks, who's on it at a glance, and Today, Tomorrow or a date in one tap.

items.title: Get the app
items.text: Using FamilyWell in a browser? Add it to your Home Screen for reminders on your phone.
